mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_wecom_tag_mapping WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND corp_id = #{corpId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_wecom_tag_mapping ( tenant_id, corp_id, crm_tag_code, wecom_group_id, wecom_group_name, wecom_tag_id, wecom_tag_name, sync_status, last_synced_at, created_by ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{corpId}, #{crmTagCode}, #{wecomGroupId}, #{wecomGroupName}, #{wecomTagId}, #{wecomTagName}, #{syncStatus}, #{lastSyncedAt}, #{actorUserId} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE wecom_group_id = VALUES(wecom_group_id), wecom_group_name = VALUES(wecom_group_name), wecom_tag_id = VALUES(wecom_tag_id), wecom_tag_name = VALUES(wecom_tag_name), sync_status = VALUES(sync_status), last_synced_at = VALUES(last_synced_at), created_by = COALESCE(VALUES(created_by), created_by), version = version + 1
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_wecom_tag_sync_run SET status = #{status}, pulled_count = #{pulledCount}, pushed_count = #{pushedCount}, skipped_count = #{skippedCount}, failed_count = #{failedCount}, error_masked = #{errorMasked}, lease_until = NULL, finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{runId} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE crm_wecom_customer_tag_push_task SET status = CASE WHEN attempts >= max_attempts THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'RETRYABLE' END, next_retry_at = CASE WHEN attempts >= max_attempts THEN NULL ELSE #{now} END, lease_until = NULL, error_masked = #{errorMasked}, version = version + 1 WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < #{now}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM crm_wecom_customer_tag_push_task WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRYABLE') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_wecom_customer_tag_push_task SET status = 'PENDING', next_retry_at = NULL, lease_until = NULL, error_masked = NULL, max_attempts = GREATEST(max_attempts, attempts + 1), version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('FAILED', 'RETRYABLE')
mapper.select: SELECT c.id AS wecomContactId, c.corp_id AS corpId, c.customer_id AS customerId, c.staff_user_id AS staffUserId, sa.wecom_userid AS wecomUserid, c.external_userid AS externalUserid, c.tag_snapshot_json AS tagSnapshotJson FROM crm_wecom_contact c INNER JOIN crm_wecom_staff_account sa ON sa.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND sa.corp_id = c.corp_id AND sa.staff_user_id = c.staff_user_id AND sa.enabled = 1 WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.corp_id = #{corpId} AND c.customer_id = #{customerId} AND c.follow_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY c.id ASC
